flow_nodes.name: Give the lego sets to the children

issues.message: The “Brick sets already ordered?” Yes path bypasses ordering the brick sets, giving them to the children, and sorting the parts, although these activities are required after the design.
issues.suggestion: Remove this bypass or route its Yes branch through the required handover and sorting activities.

issues.message: After unsuccessful tests, the process returns to “Develop basic design”; at this point the required behavior is redesigning the failed subcomponents before rebuilding them.
issues.suggestion: Rename or replace the loop-back activity with an explicit redesign step for the unsuccessful subcomponents.

issues.message: The flow labelled “Vodka bar” is guarded by a whiskey selection, so a whiskey choice is routed to the Russian team rather than the Irish team.
issues.suggestion: Change SequenceFlow_35's condition to vodka, or relabel/redirect the branch so whiskey routes to the Irish team.

", "reference_description": "L1: An e-commerce company has a comprehensive order fulfillment process:
L2: When a customer places an order, the system records the order details.
L3: Payment processing begins.
L4: If the payment fails, the customer is notified, and the process ends.
L5: Upon successful payment, the inventory system checks stock availability.
L6: If items are out of stock, a back-order is initiated, and the customer is informed about the delay.
L7: The process continues once the back-order is received and all required items are available in stock.
L8: In-stock items are picked from the warehouse.
L9: Quality control checks are performed on the picked items.
L10: Packaging is done, including gift wrapping if the customer requested it.
L11: Meanwhile, the shipping department prepares shipping documents and labels.
L12: If the order is international, customs documentation is prepared.

issues.message: The process builds subcomponents through the loop and only starts all individual tests after the loop exits, rather than testing each subcomponent after it is built.
issues.suggestion: Route each completed subcomponent to its individual test before continuing to build the next one.

issues.message: When tests are unsuccessful, the No branch performs "Assemble subcomponents" before redesigning and rebuilding.
issues.suggestion: Replace the failed-test assembly task with a redesign-and-rebuild path; allow assembly only on the successful-tests branch.

flow_nodes.name: Give the lego sets to the children

issues.message: The “Brick sets already ordered?” Yes path bypasses ordering, although ordering must follow the basic design.
issues.suggestion: Route every post-design path through ordering, or revise the requirement to explicitly allow pre-ordered sets.

issues.message: Testing begins only after the process has finished building subcomponents, rather than after each subcomponent is built.
issues.suggestion: Test each completed subcomponent before deciding whether to build the next one.

issues.message: When tests are unsuccessful, the process performs “Assemble subcomponents,” an action permitted only after successful tests.
issues.suggestion: Replace the failed-test path with redesign and rebuild activities before retesting.
